title: i2i and KCB join forces to harness data
summary: Mobigro is a mobile-based banking system that enables farmers to access credit, training, and connections in the agricultural value chain.  The plan now is to scale up this project.
body:
*Mobigro* is a mobile-based banking system that enables farmers to access credit, training, and connections in the agricultural value chain.  The plan now is to scale up this project.

i2i and [KCB Bank Kenya Limited](https://kcbbankgroup.com/), who developed *Mobigro*, have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) that sees i2i facilitate the analysis of KCB’s data on farmers in order to grow the existing coverage of this product.

I2i will work with data analysts Pula Advisors to create and segment a list of farmers from KCB’s current database. A Database Administrator will be appointed within KCB, over a period of 12 months, to assist Pula Advisors with extracting and maintaining data in the appropriate format.

This project is in its inception phase and as it develops, we will share more insights on our [News page](https://finmark.org.za/updates).
